Package com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.observability

Class RedactionProbeController

java.lang.Object
com.cognizant.emk.multiagent.infrastructure.web.observability.RedactionProbeController
@RestController public class RedactionProbeController extends Object
Test-only probe controller for the EPIC-15 / US-15-004 redaction regression test. Lives in src/test/java only — never on the main classpath — per the US-CR1-002 convention recorded in backend/CLAUDE.md.

Each endpoint emits a single INFO log statement carrying one of the three sensitive patterns the .SensitiveDataMaskingConverter is supposed to mask: Bearer <jwt>, BCrypt hash, bare JWT. The integration test captures the encoded output and asserts the raw substrings are absent.

isAuthenticated() keeps the probe consistent with the rest of the feature surface; the integration test logs in once to obtain a JWT before invoking it.
